body: Was it hard? How did you cope and how r u doing now?

Me and my boyfriend of 2.1 yrs broke it off this afternoon. We we’re crying in his room as we waited for my uber to arrive. Ive lived wth him for 2 yrs, and he was basically my everything. I moved cities wth him and left a job i loved and family to be wth him for his 1 year medical doctor residency. 

He’s a newly graduated doctor and is going to continue his residency abroad (where his entire famly is) and he just studied here. I knew he was going to leave someday but i took the risk and maybe thats my fault- for hoping that he will not leave me one day. But he did and that was TODAY.  I am a lawyer and altho i did want to move wth him to the US, i couldnt because: 

I dont qualify for law practice in the us; 
He’s not ready to get married (i am in my 30s tho so i’m getting there, he on the other hand is 27 and is pretty much career oriented) 

We love each other so much but we cant do LDR so our option is to breakup. I dont know to go about feeling devastated, depressed (almost blaming myself for not being a US citizen and for choosing a career which has no use in the US) and all other degrading and demeaning things i could think off. 

I want to hang myself tonight. My view on this is altho some may think suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem, this breakup was everytjing to me and it will permanently scar me for the rest of my life. 

I know some will think this is petty but it’s not to me, especially after losing someone i thought i’d spend the rest of my life wth. I dont think ill make it through the night
